subject: social_studies
concept: Applying group roles, fairness, trade, and cooperation to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple fair plan for a group activity, assigning roles and trades
exercise.abstract: Student explains why their plan is fair and would help the group work well together

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan reflects genuine fairness and cooperative role assignment
misconception_flags: plan assigns all the benefit or work to only one person in the group

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
